title: Single cell transcriptome from aplastic anemia (AA) and healthy donors [3' RNA-seq]
description: Transcriptome analysis of hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) and T cells collected from bone marrow and peripheral blood of healthy donors and aplastic anemia patients untreated or response to immunosuppressive therapy. Overall design: 3' end mRNA profiles of hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) and T cells under aplastic anemia (AA) and healthy conditions were generated by deep sequencing at single cell resolution, using Illumina Hiseq
